items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] No, that was Billy Morrero's band. Billy Moran's band. The Imperial, yes. It must have been the Onward band, you think? [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: He had a son who was trying to follow his footstep. I don't know if he ever kept it up, you know. Well, he was a fine musician, you know. He was, Manuel Perez also was with, one time, they had, let's see, what was the name of his band? The Superior? I think the old one. Manuel Perez? The old one. Was it the Superior?
No, that was Billy Morrero's band. Billy Moran's band. The Imperial, yes. It must have been the Onward band, you think?
